classification_findings: Author describes a 76-class 3D ResNet18: 75 spatial locations plus absence, trained with cross entropy.
Sliding-window inference uses 0.5 overlap and quantile thresholding.
Classification and detection are ensemble branches, not a classifier-filtered detection cascade.
Author says BYU classification code is not being published separately, referring to earlier CryoET code. Complete BYU classification training/inference is not established.
detector_findings: Primary author repository explicitly identifies fourth-place detection and blending.
Final detector uses hybrid 3D stem, 2D MaxViT encoder, 3D decoder, logits and offsets; four folds.
Final blending is rank-based winner takes all with double Otsu negative suppression, not coordinate/confidence averaging.
README discusses JIT or TensorRT acceleration; intake claim of TensorRT via TorchScript is not established as the sole path.
